name: outputty
description: A scaffold for developing with Claude Code, copied into the repo by /outputty:init and owned there: /plan grills, spikes every level, takes your pick and files one ticket; /tickets picks the next; /build takes it to one stacked PR per layer under a /goal you type, docs last. The tracker skill is the repo's; GitHub Issues ships as the implementation.

plugins.name: outputty
plugins.description: One command, /outputty:init, that copies the scaffold into a repo: six skills (plan, tickets, build, retro, tracker, documentation), the output style, a managed CLAUDE.md block, .claude/rules, five product docs, a ticket template, a PR template, an expert-skill template, a README template, and settings with the Fable advisor. The repo edits its copy; a re-run reports drift per file. A build runs under /goal; review is /code-review.
